ns2:course.label: Honors Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: (GEOL 293) Research in geology with honors thesis; a thesis must be submitted for credit to be received. May be repeated. No graduate credit. A maximum of 10 hours of GEOL 492 plus GEOL 493 may be counted toward graduation. Prerequisite: Consent of supervising faculty member and of departmental honors advisor.
